reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the batch report behind a QR code is more than I get from my usual brands. At $24.99 I would try one box, but only one.
objection: Two capsules every day is a chore for me, I am used to my gummies, and it is made in China so I only trust it if that lab report is real.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test showed my magnesium is fine, or if the lab report on the page did not match the batch number, I would skip it.
